name: ord_cof_eq
statement: Type*) [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] : ∃ s : Set α, IsCofinal s ∧ typeLT s = (Order.cof α).ord

name: lift_cof_iSup_add_one
statement: β → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) : Cardinal.lift.{v} (cof (⨆ i, f i + 1)) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Order.cof β)

have_tree.body: Iio (⨆ i, f i + 1)) (fun i ↦ ⟨f i, ?_⟩) := fun x y h ↦ hf h

name: sSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof
statement: Set Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}} (ha : #s < (lift.{u + 1} a).cof) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, i < a) : sSup ((· + 1) '' s) < a

name: cof_eq'
statement: α → α → Prop) [H : IsWellOrder α r] (h : IsSuccLimit (type r)) : ∃ S : Set α, (∀ a, ∃ b ∈ S, r a b) ∧ #S = cof (type r)

name: mk_bounded_subset
statement: Type*} (h : ∀ x < #α, 2 ^ x < #α) {r : α → α → Prop} [IsWellOrder α r] (hr : (#α).ord = type r) : #{ s : Set α // Bounded r s } = #α

name: mk_subset_mk_lt_cof
statement: Type*} (h : ∀ x < #α, 2 ^ x < #α) : #{ s : Set α // #s < cof (#α).ord } = #α

name: lt_power_cof_ord
statement: Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c < c ^ c.ord.cof
